name: CreateJS / TweenJS
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: Legacy tween engine from the CreateJS suite; superseded by GSAP
summary: Tweening library from the CreateJS family, animating numeric properties with eases and a chainable API, mostly paired with EaselJS canvas display lists. Ticker-driven; timelines can be paused and seeked. Unmaintained: last release May 2022, stable line is 1.x.
use_when: Maintaining an existing EaselJS project that already uses TweenJS
avoid_when: New work: GSAP has seekable nested timelines and is maintained
Plain value tweens: tween-js is smaller and maintained
Vector canvas scenes: Konva or Paper.js over EaselJS

assessment.rationale: No release since May 2022 (2.0.0-beta.4 still beta), repo idle since Dec 2023. Tweening is covered by maintained GSAP (seekable timelines) and tween-js; EaselJS neighbour is already catalogued.
